facts.fact: GAMTEL entered a US$50 million public-private partnership with SYSROAD SA HOLDING to upgrade the national broadband backbone from 40Gbps to 800Gbps; the document gives no signing date, so its published date of 2026-01-05 is used, and it calls the deal a model of African collaboration without naming SYSROAD's home country.

A signed US$50 million public-private partnership between state operator GAMTEL and SYSROAD SA HOLDING for the national broadband network, with the private partner financing the upgrade; no signing date is given, so the published date of 2026-01-05 is used.
